sentence: This project studies how natural and hybrid infrastructure holds up against hurricanes, using numerical modeling and field observations.
This project builds a way to combine information from many different data sources so that computers can learn to predict answers.
This project builds a system that uses sensors to detect pneumonia in dairy calves early and explain its predictions.
This project tests whether changing water volatility, rotation rate and land area can turn Earth-like climate models into Titan-like ones.
This project studies how the honey bee brain combines daylength and temperature cues to time its behavior.
This project studies how breaks in DNA are repaired on the sex chromosomes of the threespine stickleback fish.
This project uses operator algebra to study the limits and possibilities of quantum heat engines.
This project builds a computer tool that helps engineers plan where parts and wires go in a tight space early in design.
This project studies how a quadrotor can safely pick up a package from a person's hand while following the person's instructions.
This project studies how plants and mycorrhizal fungi interact across places and times, and how global change may disrupt those interactions.
This project builds a network of automated sensors and a data system to collect and share information from a rainforest habitat.
This project checks how well private machine learning algorithms protect the privacy of people whose data they use.
This project studies how hard it is for computers to solve certain optimization problems, using ideas from real algebraic geometry.
This project studies how to bring back supported nickel catalysts that stop working from carbon buildup and metal sintering in methane reactions.
This project covers research in robotics, including socially assistive robotics, aerial robotics, robot learning and robot manipulation.
This project studies how an unusual protein called minicollagen helps build the stinging cells found in corals and jellyfish.
This project develops ways for machine learning to learn from very little labeled data by using how systems change over time.
